blocks.content:
Elected by members of both Houses of Parliament.
State legislatures do NOT participate.
Uses proportional representation and single transferable vote.

items: Remember that State Legislatures do NOT participate in the Vice President's election (unlike the Presidential election).
The Vice President election uses Proportional Representation by means of a Single Transferable Vote.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Vice President is elected solely by members of both Houses of Parliament.
Members of State legislatures do not participate in this election.
The election follows the principle of proportional representation using the single transferable vote.
